capabilities.description: Updates AniList progress when anime is marked watched in Silo.

global_config_schema.title: AniList account
global_config_schema.description: Connect the AniList account that should receive watched progress.

fields.label: Silo profile ID
fields.description: Optional. Ignore watched events from other profiles.

global_config_schema.title: Silo API access
global_config_schema.description: A Silo API key lets the plugin resolve watched item and episode metadata.

fields.label: Silo base URL
fields.description: Optional. The plugin normally discovers this from Silo.

presentation.summary: Update AniList episode progress when anime is marked watched in Silo.
presentation.description_markdown: Consumes Silo watched-state events, resolves episode-level mappings with the daily AniBridge mapping dataset, and advances the configured AniList account without reducing existing progress.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Create an AniList OAuth access token.
2. Create a Silo API key for the account that owns the profile.
3. Configure both secrets above.
4. Optionally set the Silo profile ID when the server has multiple profiles.

The current Silo plugin API provides configuration globally, so install one instance per AniList account.
